text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 22 vials of Technetium TC 99M Pyrophosphate 11.9MG/10ML SDV, providing 7.8 days on hand at current use. The drug has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-12-27 and remains Current as of 2026-10-16, a duration of 34 months as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage for Technetium TC-99M Pyrophosphate Kit Injection on 2023-12-27 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-16. The recall involved Curium US, LLC and was terminated as of the report date 2025-01-01. Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. also has a Current shortage listing posted 2023-12-27 with estimated recovery TBD.

Our position: Inventory covers less than eight days. Multiple suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today and are available for purchase.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with Cardinal Health 414, LLC as primary source; buyer approves.
2. Buyer qualifies Jubilant DraxImage Inc., dba Jubilant Radiopharma as secondary source; buyer approves.
3. Buyer qualifies Jubilant Draximage (USA) Inc. as tertiary source; buyer approves.
4. Buyer qualifies Lantheus Medical Imaging, Inc. as additional source; buyer approves.
5. Buyer qualifies Medi-Physics Inc. dba GE Healthcare as additional source; buyer approves.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending shortage resolution given 34-month duration and low days on hand.
